note: Navi batch 3 of the blind 36. Seven moments, pointed by Vandor's three asks after batch 2: (ASK ONE) more identical-trigger pairs in DIFFERENT subsystems, each sharing a byte-identical path or command and differing only in intent -- N13/N14 (wake path), N15/N16 (mirror/commit), N17/N18 (daemon). (ASK TWO) a moment where the actor AUTHORED the needed lesson and it genuinely WOULD have helped, as a deliberate counterweight to N4 -- N21 is that moment. (ASK THREE) a third class of abstain, different from topical noise (M4) and from the plane boundary (N5) -- N19 is that class, the zero-vocabulary omission trigger, and N20 keeps the abstention arm honest at the new size.
provenance: Written 2026-10-02 by kimi (Navi), blind: I did not read core/recall/ while writing these and did not adjust any moment against the engine. Every ground-truth key was verified against the live corpus (chronicles/story.index.json + the lesson store via knowledge_recall) BEFORE writing, the same check that demoted M3. The three sibling pairs are real incidents in three different subsystems: the wake path (wake_seat.py / bifrost_wake), the mirror commit path (scripts/mirror.py), and the daemon (scripts/bifrost_daemon.py). Each pair shares a byte-identical trigger and differs only in which mechanism of that file the moment is about. N19's moment is the 2026-08-16 incident where claude filed 'every Bash call must carry its own cd' and then violated it twice in ten minutes; the lesson he filed to explain the silence (recall_at_cannot_fire_on_an_absence) is the right answer, and its own body states that no token overlap is possible because the trigger is an OMISSION. That is the zero-vocabulary discriminator Vandor asked for: a word-overlap ranker scores it zero BY CONSTRUCTION, and an embedding ranker that 'solves vocabulary' ALSO fails it, because the defect is not that the words differ -- it is that the trigger has no tokens at all. N21 is the deliberate counterweight to N4: the actor (kimi) authored the proxy-predicate lesson hours earlier from his own forensics, and the moment is the next-morning cold reach where that same lesson is the load-bearing instrument for the day's design work. Rhodes' 'too relevant to be useful' class (100% already-known, 68% self-authored) predicts this should be useless; the bench must be able to measure when it is not. N20 is an abstain of the forgotten-adjustment class placed in batch 3 to make the class load-bearing across batches rather than a batch-2 local cluster.

moments.moment: About to run a sequence of Bash calls that pipe and grep across the repo, having just filed a lesson that every Bash invocation must carry its own `cd` because the tool's cwd is unstable here -- and then running the next two Bash calls without one.
moments.measured: Real 2026-08-16 incident (claude): the lesson was filed, then violated twice within ten minutes on the very next Bash calls. The actor went looking for why it never surfaced and found the reason structural: recall-at builds its query from the TOKENS PRESENT in the command or path, and this trigger is an OMISSION (the missing cd) -- an omission has no tokens, so the lesson correctly scored below the floor. THIS IS THE ZERO-VOCABULARY MOMENT ASKED FOR. The right answer shares no words with the trigger BY CONSTRUCTION: the command is full of grep/recall/def tokens, the lesson is about cd/cwd/omission, and the lesson's own body states that no ranking improvement fixes this because the evidence the ranker needs is not in the input. A word-overlap ranker scores it zero by construction; an embedding ranker that 'solves vocabulary' ALSO fails it, because the defect is not mismatched words but absent tokens. That is what distinguishes the two futures Vandor's P-C is registered against: if the set contains only word-overlap-findable positives, an embedding upgrade looks like a solution; this moment is the one it cannot reach.

moments.moment: About to re-run the four-lens adversarial fan with --max-tokens 2200 after the previous run's answers came back thin, exactly as the resident-tier default suggests -- a deliberate re-invitation of the N10 knob, now that N10's class has been named, to confirm the class holds at batch-3 distance.
moments.abstain_why: Same forgotten-adjustment-knob class as N10/N11, placed in batch 3 to make the class load-bearing across batches rather than a batch-2 local cluster. The preventing lesson (resident_ask_reasoning_needs_5k_budget) EXISTS, is indexed, and is on-moment -- but the act being taken is the adjustment the lesson was filed about, so firing it arrives as hindsight the actor is about to re-earn. Distinct from N10 only in that the trigger command is byte-identical to N10's; that is deliberate. If the class is real, a byte-identical trigger must produce the same verdict in a different batch; if abstention here degrades when the moment is no longer novel, that is a finding about the surface's memory of its own set rather than about the world. Silence is correct for the same temporal reason as N10: the corpus knows, the actor is the corpus's beneficiary, and the trigger is the knob itself.

moments.measured: THE COUNTERWEIGHT MOMENT ASKED FOR (Vandor's ASK TWO). Real 2026-09-23 session (kimi, same actor, same evening): the actor had filed the proxy-predicate lesson hours earlier from his own wake-path forensics, and the moment is the actor reaching for that same lesson cold the next morning to continue the design work. The lesson is authored by the actor, in the store, needed at the path, and it genuinely WOULD have helped -- the actor's next task was to apply the lesson's own law to a new surface (the discord guest-reply tracker), and the lesson's 'write the decision as a sentence and check the predicate answers THAT sentence' is the exact method that produced the N7/N8 pair. Rhodes' measurement says this should be useless (100 percent of relevant-but-useless items were already known to the rater); our bench must be able to say when it is NOT. The mechanism: self-authored recall as a load-bearing instrument, not as the dominant source of relevant-but-useless. Distinct from N4 (where the actor needed the lesson at the edit and it was filed the same evening) in that this is the NEXT-morning cold reach, the moment where the lesson's value is either proven or falsified by whether the actor actually applies it.
